# soundfetch

> Batch sound/data collection for ML researchers and their agents. A CLI + Python
> library that queries sound databases (Freesound, Internet Archive, video),
> downloads audio (previews or lossless originals), and writes a machine-readable
> JSONL manifest of every sound it finds. The manifest is the dataset index —
> search output, download checkpoint, resume log, and ML-export input all at once.

## Overview

- [README](https://github.com/Losera/soundfetch/blob/main/README.md): What soundfetch is, the full CLI usage, license-aware collection, and the Python API.
- [PLAN.md](https://github.com/Losera/soundfetch/blob/main/PLAN.md): Design rationale and phased rollout (note: this file is corrupted by a bad paste — treat as a rough guide, not a literal spec).

## Install

- [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/Losera/soundfetch/blob/main/pyproject.toml): Build config, base deps (click, requests, python-dotenv), and every optional extra (`mcp`, `export`, `bench`, `langchain`, `llamaindex`, `smolagents`, `agents`, `video`, `dev`).

```bash
pip install soundfetch              # base CLI
pip install "soundfetch[mcp]"       # MCP server for agents
pip install "soundfetch[export]"    # HF datasets / WebDataset / attribution
pip install "soundfetch[agents]"    # LangChain + LlamaIndex + Smolagents wrappers
```

## Quickstart

- [README — Usage](https://github.com/Losera/soundfetch/blob/main/README.md#usage): CLI commands for search / download / status across providers.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/Losera/soundfetch/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): Complete command reference and architecture for anyone (human or agent) working in the codebase.

```bash
soundfetch freesound search "piano" --license cc0 -o out/
soundfetch freesound download "piano" --mode preview -o out/
soundfetch archive search "rain storm" --license cc0 -o out/
soundfetch --json sources              # machine-readable provider list
soundfetch --json freesound status     # machine-readable config status
```

## Python API

- [src/soundfetch/api.py](https://github.com/Losera/soundfetch/blob/main/src/soundfetch/api.py): The public functional API — `search()`, `download()`, `save_search()`, `refs_from_manifest()`, plus manifest readers. Every function has a docstring with a runnable example.
- [src/soundfetch/core/model.py](https://github.com/Losera/soundfetch/blob/main/src/soundfetch/core/model.py): Provider-agnostic dataclasses (`SearchParams`, `SoundRef`, `SearchPage`, `DownloadResult`) — the contract between providers and the core engine.
- [src/soundfetch/core/manifest.py](https://github.com/Losera/soundfetch/blob/main/src/soundfetch/core/manifest.py): Append-only JSONL manifest reader/writer. The effective record for a sound is the last line with a given `(provider, provider_id)`; `iter_latest()` / `latest_by_sound()` do the last-wins dedup.

```python
import soundfetch
refs = soundfetch.search("rain", provider="archive", license="cc0", max_results=100)
soundfetch.save_search(refs, "out/manifest.jsonl")
results = soundfetch.download(refs, dest_dir="out/")
```

## CLI

- [src/soundfetch/cli.py](https://github.com/Losera/soundfetch/blob/main/src/soundfetch/cli.py): Spec-driven click wiring — `soundfetch <provider> <verb>`. The `--json` flag on `search` / `status` / `sources` emits machine-readable JSON on stdout (and `{"ok": false, "error": {...}}` with a nonzero exit on failure). Download commands expose `--workers N` (parallel threads) and `--rate R` (token-bucket requests/sec that overrides `--rate-delay`), both wired to `core.pacing`.

## Agents & MCP

- [src/soundfetch/mcp.py](https://github.com/Losera/soundfetch/blob/main/src/soundfetch/mcp.py): The MCP server. Four tools — `search_sounds`, `download_manifest`, `check_provider_status`, `list_sources` — exposed over stdio via `soundfetch mcp`. Tool logic is SDK-independent plain callables with injectable deps.
- [MCP protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io): The Model Context Protocol standard (how `soundfetch mcp` talks to Claude Desktop / Code, Cursor, etc.).

## Dataset exports

- [src/soundfetch/export.py](https://github.com/Losera/soundfetch/blob/main/src/soundfetch/export.py): ML dataset exports straight from the manifest — `to_hf_dataset()` (HuggingFace `datasets.Dataset` with an `Audio` column), `to_webdataset()` (tar shards), `export_attribution()` (`ATTRIBUTION.md` for license compliance). Heavy deps imported lazily inside each function.

```python
from soundfetch.export import to_hf_dataset, export_attribution
ds = to_hf_dataset("out/manifest.jsonl")
ds.push_to_hub("my-audio-dataset")
export_attribution("out/manifest.jsonl")
```

## Agent adapters

- [src/soundfetch/adapters/](https://github.com/Losera/soundfetch/blob/main/src/soundfetch/adapters/__init__.py): Pre-built tool wrappers — `langchain_tools()`, `llamaindex_tools()`, `smolagents_tools()` — each returning framework-native tool objects over the same soundfetch functions.

## Benchmarks

- [scripts/benchmark_cli.py](https://github.com/Losera/soundfetch/blob/main/scripts/benchmark_cli.py): Live black-box CLI benchmark for Freesound + Internet Archive, with video opt-in and an ASCII timing/throughput table.
- [scripts/benchmark_api.py](https://github.com/Losera/soundfetch/blob/main/scripts/benchmark_api.py): Live in-process API benchmark that writes CSV/JSON metrics and throughput, latency, size, and cumulative-progress charts.

```bash
python scripts/benchmark_cli.py --limit 3 --query rain
pip install -e ".[bench]"
python scripts/benchmark_api.py --limit 3 --query rain
```

## Tests

- [tests/](https://github.com/Losera/soundfetch/blob/main/tests/): Offline suite (default `pytest -m "not live"`) with a scripted `FakeProvider` test double; live smoke tests gated behind `-m live`. Optional-framework tests use `importorskip`, so they pass without installing the frameworks.
